text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijiiiin!
Yukinoooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for all your s'pport!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whew... Now that's what I call a race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(The cheers are louder than they were at
the
Osaka Hai! Still not as good as last
year,
though...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(It just goes t'show that steal'n hearts is
no walk in
the park.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Noth'n wrong with that though. I know I
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My dream'll come true! I just gotta keep
at it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is there something different about
Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After congratulating Yukino Bijin on a
race
well-run, we head back to campus.
On the way
back, she spots a familiar
face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! It's City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hi, Yukino. I saw the race. Great job
today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you did?! Wowie, that makes me so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Say, Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've... changed, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, am I s'posed t'be in my racewear
right
now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean. I'm not sure how
to
explain it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I always knew you weren't one to give
up. But
today...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Today, I saw you run with more
confidence than
you've ever had before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Aw, you're mak'n me
blush.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: How do you do it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You must have had times where you felt
utterly
lost.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So how are you able to take on all that
and still
look so... bold?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks at Yukino Bijin eagerly as if
expecting
an answer that will solve all
her own problems.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's not like I'm a hundred
percent
conf'dent in myself...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But maybe it's 'cause I've got a clear
idea of who
it is I wanna be.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Up till now, it's just been blind luck that
people
happened t'like me. I was just
the right person at
the right time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But now... I wanna b'come someone I can like too. That's what I'm runn'n for.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And if everyone ends up liking that
person... well,
that'd just be the swellest
thing there is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's not a very concrete goal, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How can you even know whether or not
you've
done it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T'be honest, I'm not quite sure m'self!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I decided that's what I'm gonna do,
so that
what I'm gonna do! Even if it
takes a hundred
years, I'll keep on
runn'n till I do it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're a really strong person, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I dunno know if I'd say that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for bothering you. Make sure to
get a good
rest tonight, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wonder what's going on with City.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right... But I know she can
do it.
She's City, after all.
choice_data_list: 彼女なりの考えがあるんだろうな
彼女なりの考えがあるんだろうね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's talk about my next race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The same thing as always! I wanna look
super
spiffy runn'n in front of a huge
crowd!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After doing so well in the Victoria Mile,
I'm sure
Yukino Bijin will want to step it
up and win an
even bigger challenge.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Queen... Gracious. You really know how
t'rattle
my nerves.
choice_data_list: 『エリザベス女王杯』が合うと思う

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I'll handle it just like t'day! I just
gotta keep
on keep'n on, right?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! The up-and-comers...
choice_data_list: クラシック級の子に、背中を見せてあげよう

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now that's nerve-rattl'n. I wonder who'll be there...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Hishiama...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is a head above her peers
in the
year below. With natural talent
like hers, one
might say she was born for
victory.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If she'll be there, then I've gotta be a
good role
model and show her the ropes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Usually, I'm the one rely'n on her. Feels
a bit
weird to think we're pull'n a
switcheroo.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I gotta say... being a role model's
got a nice
ring to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided on the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup as our next race.
